ruleDefinitions.name: Use Short Name Path in Image
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image detection

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\\.*")) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\Dism\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\cleanmgr\.exe") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WebEx\\\\WebexHost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\thor\\\\thor64\\\.exe$")) OR process_product = "InstallShield\ \(R\)" OR process_description = "InstallShield\ \(R\)\ Setup\ Engine" OR process_company = "InstallShield\ Software\ Corporation") OR ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\~1\\\\unzip\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\~1\\\\7zG\\\.exe$"))))
